Reran inputs/artifacts/verify_discrepancy.py: VERIFY_OK, both exact integer engines agree. Independently recomputed from scratch with Fractions (occupancy enumeration over all 4 edge-inclusion types): all 8 rows match digit-for-digit: 9/25, 15/64, 28/169, 16/147, 41/578, 136/3025, 246/7921, 13/648 with stated extremal boxes/counts. Grid-corner reduction is valid: both coordinates lie on (1/N)Z so on each cell A is constant while volume varies monotonically; sup over anchored boxes equals max over (N+1)^2 corners including open/mixed left-limit volumes; all 8 winners are closed type so sup is attained. Dual witnesses (§3) independently recomputed: shortest dual vectors, |h*|^2, H=12 hit counts (24,36,48,30,16,10,4,2) and Q_H all match. §§4-5 (three-distance census, Kronecker rows) are explicitly labeled float evidence, not proof — honest separation, not a correctness defect for the headline.

originality.rationale: Nearest priors give different invariants or general bounds, not this per-set exact L_inf star table. Weiss 2411.10363: Hammersley upper bound 2.463*sqrt(d/N), upper-only, different object. Clement et al. 2311.17463: optimal L_inf star sets known only n<=6 in d=2 (computed to 21 points), optimal sets ~50% better than standard constructions for n>=7 — confirms N=5..144 exact star values are hard and no Fibonacci F5-F12 table given. Hinrichs et al. 2005.09933: exact extreme/periodic L2 (diaphony) formulas for Hammersley/rational lattices, not L_inf star; shows Fibonacci L2 optimal order only. Kuipers-Niederreiter and Drmota-Tichy monographs: general ETK/three-distance theory, no per-set table. arXiv search 'Fibonacci lattice star discrepancy exact' returned no results. Internal resultary SCOPE021 (minima over 2313 noble-tail irrationals at N=512,1024,2048) has disjoint N-range and different object/claim form; SCOPE-FAIL-20260907-043 (cubic-norm uniform bound) is abandoned route. No source publishes these 8 exact rationals with extremal boxes.

value.rationale: Strongest headline is a rigorously established exact invariant of a specific natural object: exact L_inf star discrepancy of the 8 classical Fibonacci lattices F5-F12 (N=5..144) with logged extremal anchored boxes plus exact dual shortest-vector witnesses. Object (Fibonacci lattices) and invariant (star discrepancy controlling Koksma-Hlawka QMC error) were motivated before computation via Weyl/Bakhvalov/Roth-Schmidt programs. Values were not known and are not mechanically implied by order bounds (O(log N/N)) or L2 formulas. Future QMC lattice-rule selection, uniformity testing, and discrepancy-code validation can cite exact rows directly. Narrow exact datum is eligible per value standard; certification alone is supplemented by natural object, prior motivation, extremal-box interpretation, and replayable proof. Incomplete ETK/Kronecker/Ostrowski survey is honestly limited and does not erase headline value.

residual_risks: Literature search is bounded (arXiv + monographs + resultary); an obscure textbook exercise could list one small-N value (e.g. N=5), but no full 8-row table with witnesses was found.
Float §§4-5 are replayable but not interval-certified; a future user must not cite them as proved enclosures — DRAFT states this explicitly.
Star-discrepancy convention (closed vs half-open boxes) affects unattained suprema in general; here all maxima are closed/attained, so convention risk is discharged for this table.
